# YeahCore

> YeahCore (formerly core.yeahvibe.com) is HappyBein's open knowledge base: the human needs and drivers behind what people want, and practical frameworks for making better decisions. YeahSight (https://yeahsight.happybein.com) builds on it to understand society; the YeahVibe tools (https://yeahvibe.com) help people act on it in daily life.
>
> It provides practical frameworks, best practices, and curated tools across personal effectiveness, organizational processes, collaboration, and societal awareness. YeahCore is an initiative of the HappyBein Stichting — a Dutch foundation dedicated to well-being and positive impact.

## Mission

Stop managing time. Start building leverage.

YeahCore helps people get more value from the time and resources they have — not by working harder, but by working smarter. Every article is written to be read in 3–5 minutes and applied immediately.

## The 5 Pillars of Leverage

YeahCore is organized around five pillars, each targeting a specific type of challenge:

### Pillar 1 — Defining Direction & Priorities
**Remedy for:** Feeling directionless or paralyzed by too many choices.
**Insight:** Don't just optimize your schedule; optimize your life. Defining your North Star ensures every other effort actually counts.
**URL:** https://yeahcore.happybein.com/pillars/direction/

### Pillar 2 — Enhancing the Mindset
**Remedy for:** Feeling unmotivated, stuck, or mentally overwhelmed.
**Insight:** Your mindset is your internal operating system. Cognitive reframing and resilience make growth sustainable.
**URL:** https://yeahcore.happybein.com/pillars/mindset/

### Pillar 3 — Organizing Your Surroundings & Processes
**Remedy for:** Feeling disorganized, scattered, or physically drained.
**Insight:** Success is a product of low friction. Optimize your environment so the right actions become the easiest actions.
**URL:** https://yeahcore.happybein.com/pillars/organization/

### Pillar 4 — Collaboration & Leadership Principles
**Remedy for:** Feeling stressed by a heavy workload or isolated in your goals.
**Insight:** You can only go so far alone. Influence and collaboration are the multipliers that scale your impact through others.
**URL:** https://yeahcore.happybein.com/pillars/collaboration/

### Pillar 5 — YeahSight: Picturing the World
**Remedy for:** Feeling concerned about the world's future.
**Insight:** To win, you must see the board. YeahSight helps you understand global trends to define a confident long-term direction.
**URL:** https://yeahcore.happybein.com/pillars/yeahsight/
